channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Aldi grocery store opens Wednesday in Hobe Sound at former Winn-Dixie site
item.description: Hobe Sound is getting its first Aldi store when the new grocery store opens July 9 at 8867 SE Bridge Road.

item.title: Martin County School District plans to eliminate 16 administrative positions, saving nearly $4 million
item.description: The Martin County School District plans to cut 16 administrative and district-level positions and remove 42 unfilled instructional vacancies as part of a reorganization for the upcoming school year.

item.title: Vero Beach homeowner says $9,000 insurance costs may force her to sell home
item.description: Kelly Hagen says her homeowners insurance premium has jumped from $6,000 to $9,000 a year, equating to $750 a month on top of her mortgage payment.

item.title: Martin County School District plans to cut staff and save nearly $4 million
item.description: The Martin County School District plans to cut district staff as part of a reorganization for the upcoming school year, saving nearly $4 million from next year's budget.

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina survives Cape Verde 3-2 in World Cup Round of 16 thriller
item.description: Lionel Messi and defending World Cup champion Argentina beat Cape Verde 3-2 in a match that went to extra time, with the go-ahead goal coming in the 111th minute.
